strings.name: Spike Lee
strings.role: Film director, writer, producer and teacher
strings.summary: Spike Lee draws on Brooklyn communities and Black life to examine race, urban relationships and American history in fiction and documentary. Do the Right Thing, Malcolm X and BlacKkKlansman express his distinctive voice. He works across independent and mainstream cinema and has long taught filmmakers at NYU.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Works including Do the Right Thing sustain discussions of race, community and history and bring Black experience into mainstream cinema.
